title: Quintessential Wood-Fired Indian Lamb Biryani
description: A rich and flavorful wood-fired Indian dish featuring tender lamb, fragrant basmati rice, and caramelized onions.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400°F (200°C) and let it heat for at least 30 minutes.
Soak the basmati rice in water for 30 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In a large kadhai, heat 1 tablespoon of clarified butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are caramelized and golden brown, stirring occasionally.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cumin seeds and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, stirring occasionally.
Add the coriander powder, garam masala powder, and salt. Mix well.
Add the soaked and drained basmati rice to the kadhai and mix well with the lamb and spice mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a large wooden bowl or a heatproof ceramic dish.
Cover the bowl or dish with a lid or foil and place it in the wood-fired oven.
Bake the biryani for 25-30 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the lamb is tender.
Remove the bowl or dish from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff the biryani with a fork and serve hot.
